mapper.select:
SELECT TOP (200) MSG_KEY AS msgid, CASE WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'ALT' THEN 'AT' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'ALI' THEN 'AI' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'FRT' THEN 'FT' WHEN MSG_TYPE IN ('FRI','FRW') THEN 'FI' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'BRI' THEN 'E1' WHEN MSG_TYPE IN ('SMS','LMS','MMS') THEN 'PH' ELSE MSG_TYPE END AS messagetype, MESSAGE AS msg, MESSAGE AS msgsms, 'P' AS pcom, SUBJECT AS smslmstit, CALL_TO AS phn, CALL_FROM AS smssender, FORMAT(RES_DATE, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') AS reservedt, FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS regdt, SENDER_KEY AS profile, TEMPLATE_CODE AS tmplid, BUTTON AS button, FILE_NAME1 AS filepath1, FILE_NAME2 AS filepath2, FILE_NAME3 AS filepath3 FROM ${msg_table} WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MSG_STATE = '1' AND RES_DATE <= GETDATE()
AND MSG_TYPE IN ('ALT', 'ALI')
AND MSG_TYPE IN ('FRT', 'FRI', 'FRW')
AND MSG_TYPE = 'SMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'LMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'MMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'BRI'
ORDER BY MSG_KEY ASC
